boundaries: A formula alone does not validate what a score means.
Changing weights, transformations or missingness rules creates a new score version.
claim_ceiling: Generated project-scoped candidate Definition record only. Shape and projection checks grant no Lab admission, semantic truth, implementation, collection or employment-use authority.

scope.applicability: One score version and compatible role, cases, rubrics and modes.
exclusions: Any other product or Lab-wide meaning without separate owner review and admission.

domain_context.explanation: Candidate Scoring Specification meaning for the Engineer Assessment product and research program. Its construct, implementation and use claims remain bounded by the source statement.

plain_language.explanation: It is the recipe that turns evidence-based ratings into a reportable number and states when that number should not be used.

boundary_conditions: A formula alone does not validate what a score means.
Changing weights, transformations or missingness rules creates a new score version.
scientific_formal.formal_expression: S_v = f_v(ratings, missingness, case, role, mode)
scientific_formal.normative_statement: A Scoring Specification is a versioned rule set mapping elicited Criterion Ratings and declared missingness to session and optional composite scores, uncertainty and permitted interpretations for one declared formative or role-linked purpose.
